w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Redactor.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: Back at the haven the argument starts: the person in their 30s, with calloused knuckles is calling it "Old Gavel." The name's up for grabs — weigh in if you want.

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Focus Group.

w3Mentions.name: Spool
w3Mentions.firstLine: The Spool stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — Chorus Line.

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Callback.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: It's settled. The village is calling it "Ugly-Eyes." The Codex keeps it.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
📺 SYSTEM: "CONTEST: Gauntlet. Three waves, no rest. Survive all three and the crowd goes wild. Most don't see wave two."

loss.line: Haven couldn't hold. On the third hungry day, people started walking — in different directions. The scattering, again.
